Part 1 高频 事件 EVENTS

Typing

打字

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you prefer typing or handwriting?

I definitely prefer typing, to be honest. I'm on my computer most of the day, so typing feels natural, and it's much faster than writing by hand. Honestly, my handwriting isn't great either, which is another reason.

更喜欢打字，天天用电脑打字自然又快；手写字不好看也是原因。

Q2Do you type on a desktop or laptop keyboard every day?

Yeah, every day, definitely. I mainly use my laptop keyboard, since I take it with me everywhere, to class and back home. I find laptop keys a bit softer than desktop ones, but I've gotten used to them.

每天都打字，主要用笔记本键盘，随身带方便；已习惯笔记本较软的键感。

Q3When did you learn how to type on a keyboard?

I first learned to type back in primary school, during our computer classes. We practised basic keyboarding there, and honestly, I picked it up quite quickly because I enjoyed playing around on the machines.

小学计算机课第一次学打字，因为喜欢玩电脑学得很快。

Q4How do you improve your typing?

Well, for me it was mostly gaming, to be honest. Chatting with teammates during online games forced me to type fast, so my speed improved naturally. These days I get plenty of practice through coursework and chatting with AI.

靠打游戏和队友打字沟通练快了速度；现在靠写作业和跟AI聊天保持。
